description.value: Maple Bay is one of four campgrounds at Cultus Lake Park, a busy Lower Mainland favourite set beside a large warm freshwater lake about 10 km from Sardis via paved highway; showers and full services, but expect crowds in summer.

raw_osm.name: Maple Bay Campground
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Maple Bay Campground is one of four campgrounds within Cultus Lake Provincial Park, near Chilliwack. The website mentions 'Book camping' and 'Reservation policies,' confirming reservations are accepted. The nearby community of Cultus Lake is described as having 'restaurants, stables, laundromat, stores, and gas stations,' confirming food nearby. OSM tags provide the sanitary dump station and capacity (106 sites). Most specific campground amenities (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites) are not detailed on the general park page.
concerns: Website URL is for the parent Cultus Lake Provincial Park, not specifically for Maple Bay Campground
No address provided in OSM; park is accessed off Highway 1 at Yarrow or Sardis exits
Phone and email belong to the operator (Sea to Sky Park Services), not BC Parks directly
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Maple Bay Campground is a real, operating BC Parks campground within Cultus Lake Provincial Park, well-suited for touring cyclists passing through the Chilliwack area with reservable sites and nearby services.

wow_evidence: busy Lower Mainland favourite set beside a large warm freshwater lake... showers and full services
